description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useDragSelect' for handling drag-based selection interactions on a horizontal lane, allowing users to create chunks by clicking and dragging. It manages state for the drag rectangle, computes positions, and triggers creation callbacks when a threshold is exceeded.

methods.name: useDragSelect({ onCreate, pxToMs })
methods.description: A React hook that provides handlers and state for drawing a selection rectangle, enabling drag creation of chunks on a horizontal lane.
